closureInstruction: Reflect the verified remediation achievements into smar only, then stop. Do not continue toward master without a separate explicit human command.

workBranch.definition: A primary human-owned work branch created from master, such as reemsam, lianbassam, sambassam, or a similar named delivery branch.

automaticRemediationSubBranch.definition: A temporary branch created automatically from a work branch to repair, diagnose, or remediate a bounded task.

rules.requirement: A work branch created from master must never be merged into master automatically; merging it into master requires an explicit human command.
Any automatically created remediation or correction subbranch must open and complete its merge back into the exact work branch it was created from.
An automatic remediation subbranch must not target master unless its origin branch is master and the task explicitly records that origin.
Before merging an automatic subbranch, compare origin work branch, automatic subbranch, and master to prove no work-branch commits are dropped or overwritten.
Do not force-move a work branch or master to absorb remediation output. Use pull-request merge semantics or a reviewed fast-forward that preserves the origin branch commits.
Automated remediation must not push, merge, or publish directly with write permissions unless a separate reviewed policy explicitly allows it for the same origin work branch.
